title: The isolation seam: one trait, one façade, the worktree backend moved behind it
summary: Add bridge/src/isolation with the Isolation enum (worktree | cow, read from disk by Isolation::of), IsolationAvailability and the seven-primitive IsolationBackend trait; move today's git-linked-worktree code into WorktreeBackend; turn WorktreeManager into the façade that cuts branches, picks the directory and routes to backends, absorbing Orchestrator::merge_into_base and gaining publish/sync_base/discover/prune and the project-repo ref operations; split describe_checkout out of the porcelain parser and put isolation on ExternalWorktree. Creation calls take an Isolation argument; the app passes Worktree. No behavior change; existing tests prove it.

title: Route every checkout operation in the app through the façade
summary: Delete app.rs's own git for finishing a worktree (remove_registered_worktree, merge_external_branch, local_branch_exists, delete_local_branch_for_finish, restore_finish_branch_after_removal_failure), the scan wrappers and the best-effort worktree prune, and call the WorktreeManager façade instead; classify_stage_publication publishes the checkout's branch first. Behavior unchanged; after this stage a second backend needs no app changes.

title: The copy-on-write backend and the availability probe
summary: Implement CowBackend (clonefile on macOS, per-file FICLONE reflink on Linux; strip inherited .git/worktrees, write the .git/build-isolation marker, check out the branch, clean untracked, keep ignored caches) with publish/sync_base as local fetches by path, discovery by marker under the worktrees root, and cow_availability (same .git directory, same volume, a real clone probe) with user-facing reasons. Wired into the façade but not yet selectable. Tests run the real clone on APFS and skip with a printed reason on ext4.

title: The isolation setting: account default, per-project override, locked when unavailable
summary: Persist an account-level isolation setting and a per-project override in the bridge config; one resolver (override, else account, downgraded to worktree with the probe's reason when cow is unavailable) feeds every creation site, and a downgrade is recorded on the thread. settings.get/set gain isolation and isolation_available; project.list rows gain isolation, isolation_effective, isolation_available; new project.set_isolation. cow is refused wherever the probe fails.

title: The isolation controls: account settings panel and project settings select
summary: A pure core/isolation.js mirroring core/defaultHarness.js, a Work isolation panel under Default agent on the Settings page, a Work isolation select in the project settings sheet with an Account default option, the copy-on-write option disabled with the bridge's reason when locked, and the effective isolation shown on each project row. Vitest first, then a browser pass.
